description: Change which existing open tab the AI is acting on. By default this does NOT change what the user sees — the user's foreground tab stays put — it only retargets subsequent playwright_* calls. Pass bringToFront=true to also surface the tab in the user's window (only do this if the user explicitly asked to be shown that tab).

bringToFront.description: Whether to also foreground the tab in the user's window. Default false — switches the AI's internal active tab without stealing focus from the user. Set true only if the user explicitly asked to be shown that tab.

index.description: Zero-based index of the tab to switch to

name: playwright_switch_tab
